primitives.name: Browser Feed Pass
primitives.verbatim_quote: Browser For You feed pass (browser-task:45862e78, runtime-measured 8:10–8:37 PM CDT, fresh window): 72 rows viewed → 59 content entries (52 carrying status IDs, 7 without), 0 promoted posts in the timeline, 3 trading-related skips (counted, not opened, no IDs returned), 3 browser tool-interaction rows excluded.
primitives.assumptions: Feed is read-only and no user interaction affects content delivery.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Content filtering by presence of status ID and exclusion of non-content rows.

layer2.mapping: GSE uses this to simulate user attention paths; GSI applies it to validate feed consistency against known content sources.
layer2.telemetry: Total entries processed (N_entries), number of unique IDs (N_IDs), and skipped/non-skipped ratios.

primitives.name: Luck Adjusted EPA
primitives.verbatim_quote: **@sfdata9ers — the luck factor (W1)** — opponent FG-miss expected points (PIT +13.5, LAC +13.1, DET +11.9; KC/NO 0): a fully in-house-reproducible luck ledger that discounts every defensive ranking GSE prints.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\Delta \\text{EPA}_{\\text{adj}}': 'adjusted EPA (points per play)', '\\text{EPA}_{\\text{raw}}': 'raw EPA (points per play)', '\\text{EP}_{\\text{missed FG}_i}': 'expected points from missed FG (points)'}
primitives.assumptions: Expected points from missed FGs are independently distributed and known from historical data.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Regression correction for defensive performance due to opponent field goal misses.

layer2.mapping: GSE models defensive strength using this metric to adjust situational EPA estimates; GSI uses it to correct for stochastic variance in team rankings.
layer2.telemetry: Difference between raw EPA and adjusted EPA (ΔEPA_adj), and per-team EP from missed FGs.

reasoning_traces.think:
The primitives form a layered inference pipeline: first, a watchlist deep pass generates a new batch of posts (N_new = 40) via Grok x_search, which are then filtered through a browser feed pass (N_entries = 59) to isolate content with status IDs. This ensures that each new post contributes to the seen index (N_seen = 1,366 → 1,448) and avoids redundancy. The third primitive, luck-adjusted EPA, introduces a correction term to raw EPA values using expected points from missed field goals. This correction is derived from a regression ledger built on NFLverse data and a public FG probability curve. The resulting ΔEPA_adj adjusts team performance metrics to reflect true skill rather than luck. These operations collectively enable GSI to maintain a consistent knowledge base and GSE to model team dynamics with reduced noise.
